federation.binding: Workforce Identity Federation to Google Cloud

identity.note: No Google Cloud API activity recorded for this identity on 2026-04-13. The federated path exists but was not exercised during the incident window.

bindings.note: Folder-level grant. Applies to every bucket in three projects.

effective_permissions.assessment: This identity has read access to client holdings and trade history in BigQuery and to every Cloud Storage bucket under the Investment Operations folder. None of it was accessed during the incident.

issues.title: Federated identity has folder-level storage read across production data
issues.subject: s.hudson@cymbal-investments.com
issues.detail: roles/storage.objectViewer granted at folders/cymbal-investment-ops via group:investment-operations. Scope exceeds the buckets this role is used against.

issues.title: Service account key unused for over 180 days
issues.subject: invops-report-runner@cymbal-invops-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
issues.detail: Key created 2025-06-02, last used 2025-09-30. The service account is impersonable by group:investment-operations.

issues.title: Workforce pool provider has no session duration limit
issues.subject: workforcePools/cymbal-workforce/providers/okta-saml
issues.detail: Sessions established through this provider inherit the default duration. A compromised identity provider session remains usable in Google Cloud for longer than necessary.

steps.description: Okta session assumed via Workforce Identity Federation
Group membership grants folder-level storage read
Impersonate service account reachable from that group
Service account holds BigQuery read on client holdings

attack_path.assessment: A four-step path exists from the compromised identity to client holdings data in BigQuery. Cloud audit logs show no activity from this identity on 2026-04-13, so the path was available but not taken. It remains open.

audit_logs.note: No Google Cloud audit log entries match. The attacker IP 149.50.97.144 does not appear in cloud audit logs at any point.
